violations.description: Ensures the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
Ensures table headers have discernible text
Ensures the order of headings is semantically correct
Ensures every HTML document has a lang attribute
Ensures elements have alternate text or a role of none or presentation
Ensures the document has a main landmark
Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color
Ensures all page content is contained by landmarks
